As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] beginning in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the '''Magnus''', or [[Magnus (title)|ruler]], of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] and [[O'reenian|its people]] faced the threat of invasion when a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|military exploration ship]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stumbled upon O'reen while searching for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] supply outposts. When the O'reenians took the crew [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] them, the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]] came to mount a rescue along with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Vornskr Company]]. The Magnus ordered the O'reenian military to resist the invaders, but during the ensuing [[Rescue on O'reen|conflict]], the leader was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The ruler was succeeded by [[Unidentified Magnus (post-Clone Wars rescue)|another Magnus]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
